source: D&D 5e Player's Handbook (2014), p. 17-31; trait and spell references cross-checked against the local SRD 5.1 files
notes: These are the five PHB (2014) subraces absent from SRD 5.1. 5e-SRD-Subraces.json already contains hill-dwarf, high-elf, lightfoot-halfling and rock-gnome, so there is no index collision.

`traitRefs` holds only indexes that exist in 5e-SRD-Traits.json. Traits that have no SRD entry (Fleet of Foot, Mask of the Wild, Drow Magic, Stout Halfling Vitality) carry the verbatim PHB text in `traitText` instead.
Traits granted by the parent race are deliberately NOT repeated here: Darkvision, Fey Ancestry, Keen Senses, Trance (elf), Dwarven Resilience, Stonecunning (dwarf), Gnome Cunning (gnome).
`naturally-stealthy` belongs to the lightfoot halfling, not the stout halfling, so the stout halfling has no trait references.
The wood elf's additional language is represented by the SRD `extra-language` trait; `languages` is therefore empty because the language is a choice, not a fixed grant.
The drow is not a race or subrace in SRD 5.1, so its Darkvision comes from the drow entry in the PHB rather than a local reference.

`cantrips` lists SRD spell indexes. The PHB describes faerie fire as one of the drow's Drow Magic cantrips, but in SRD 5.1 faerie fire is a 1st-level spell (dancing lights is the only 0-level one). The PHB wording is preserved and the discrepancy is recorded here.
The drow's darkness is a once-per-long-rest 3rd-level cast without material components; it is recorded in `spells`, not `cantrips`.
The forest gnome's minor illusion is a permanent innate cantrip, so it is recorded as a spell index rather than as a trait.
`speedOverride` is only present when the subrace changes the parent's walking speed.
Armor, weapon and hit-point bonuses below are the exact PHB grants; subraces without them carry empty arrays so every entry has the same shape.

Mountain Dwarf grants +2 Strength only. The dwarf ancestry already grants +2 Constitution, so a second +1 here would double-count it; the +1 Constitution shown on Mountain Dwarf in the 2024 version is not PHB 2014 and is excluded.

Mountain Dwarf lists no weapon proficiencies because the dwarven-combat-training trait in 5e-SRD-Traits.json already grants battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer and warhammer. Adding `simple-weapons` here would wrongly grant every simple weapon.
Curated because 5e-SRD-Subraces.json publishes only hill-dwarf, high-elf, lightfoot-halfling and rock-gnome.

subraces.name: Mountain Dwarf
subraces.hitPointsBonus: 1 at 1st level, then 1 at every level after 1st

traitText.name: Fleet of Foot
desc: Your walking speed increases to 35 feet.

traitText.name: Mask of the Wild
desc: You have a limited supernatural intuition. While you are disguised as a creature of your race, you have advantage on Intuition checks to hide.

subraces.name: Drow

traitText.name: Drow Magic
desc: At 1st level, you know the dancing lights and faerie fire cantrips. In addition, at 3rd level, you can cast the darkness spell once per long rest without material components.

notes: The PHB lists Dancing Lights and Faerie Fire as drow cantrips and Darkness as a 3rd-level spell usable once per long rest.
SRD 5.1.2 files faerie-fire as a 1st-level spell instead of a cantrip. The PHB grouping is kept here; validate-srd.mjs reports the discrepancy as a warning.
Drow Magic also grants Darkvision, which the SRD already publishes separately as the darkvision trait.

traitText.name: Stout Halfling Vitality
desc: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.
